thread:
Erica (Mktg): heads up — we had a pile of inbound leads marked unassigned overnight for EMEA. saw this in the weekly handoff dashboard.
Mike - SalesOps: ugh. timeline? how many?
Erica (Mktg): ~120 between 10pm-6am UTC, most are timezone-tagged, some with enrichment delay.
Juan G: are these failing the HubSpot owner-rule? or SFDC sync lag?
Olivia CS: looks like owner-rule evaluated but enrichment webhook didn't return company data, so rule skipped assignment.
Mike - SalesOps: ok that's the round-robin gate. if enrichment missing -> we fall through to no-owner. need a guardrail.
Erica (Mktg): suggestion: add a temporary "overnight bridge" that assigns to a fallback pool when timezone within EMEA and owner is null after X minutes.
Juan G: agree. set X = 15m? gives enrichment time but doesn't leave leads unowned for the whole day.
Olivia CS: 15m works. also add a tag so we can filter those for manual quality review.
Mike - SalesOps: implementation plan: 1) HubSpot workflow change: add delay 15m, check contact.owner, if empty -> set owner to "EMEA-night-fallback" and add property inbound_fallback:true. 2) SFDC flow mirror. 3) Rollout in canary for one country (UK) first.
Erica (Mktg): can we webhook-enrich faster? maybe parallelize enrichment calls at receive-time for timezone-prioritized leads.
Juan G: enrichment is rate-limited overnight due to token bucket config on the lambda. we can bump for a short window but prefer fallback pattern to avoid spikes.
Mike - SalesOps: I'll draft the HubSpot workflow condition. snippet below: \n```
Trigger: Contact created OR Lead converted
Action: Delay for 15 minutes
Condition: contact.owner IS_EMPTY AND contact.timezone IN (Europe/London, Europe/Dublin, Europe/Amsterdam, Europe/Berlin)
Then: Set contact.owner = "EMEA-night-fallback"; Set contact.property.inbound_fallback = "true"
```
Olivia CS: add note to set a soft SLA: handoff within 15m for timezone EMEA, escalate if still unowned after 2h.
Erica (Mktg): love that — escalation should page SDR lead and create a ticket in the handoff queue.
HubSpot Sync Bot: webhook 8732 delivered, enrichment job queued (id: enq-2026-03-22-007).
Juan G: let's also add a TTL tag so the fallback owner releases to real owner when enrichment completes. HubSpot API call: `PUT /contacts/:id` body `{ "properties": [{"property": "owner","value":"{{real_owner_id}}"},{"property":"inbound_fallback","value":"false"}]}`
Mike - SalesOps: rollout checklist: doc changes, workflow change in HS test portal, SFDC flow mirror, canary on UK for 48h, metrics to watch: unassigned_count, fallback_assign_rate, reassign_rate, SLA_violation_count.
Erica (Mktg): I'll own comms to SDRs + add to the playbook (how to handle fallback owners).
Olivia CS: quick question — do we want different fallback pools by workload (enterprise vs trial)?
Juan G: yes, separate pools makes sense. add condition: contact.segment == enterprise -> assign to EMEA-enterprise-fallback.
Mike - SalesOps: noted. I'll make a draft change and post it here for review in the morning. :eyes:
Erica (Mktg): thanks team — big win if we cut overnight unassigned to near zero. will monitor dashboard after canary. :raised_hands:
Olivia CS: also schedule a 1-week post-rollout review to check quality and reassign churn.
Mike - SalesOps: posting draft in #marketing this afternoon.
Juan G: thumbs up.
